title: Knotted Crunchy Scottish Fish Sandwich
description: A fresh and cozy Scottish dish featuring crispy fish, pickle, and potato buns, perfect for a satisfying lunch. This pescatarian-friendly recipe is easy to make and delicious to eat.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the cod fillets into chunky pieces and season with salt and pepper.
Dip each piece of cod into the beer batter mix, coating evenly.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and fry the battered cod until golden brown.
Transfer the fried cod to a baking sheet and bake in the oven for 10 minutes.
Toast the potato buns by grilling them lightly.
Assemble the sandwiches by placing a piece of cod on each bun, followed by a spoonful of pickle slices and a squeeze of lemon juice.
